body.name: One-root star rank-obstruction family
body.construction: For every \(p\ge2\), take the one-root star with root \(1\), edges \(1\to j\) of coefficients \(b_j\neq0\) for \(j=2,\ldots,p\), positive baseline variances \(\omega_j\), and positive intervention variances \(\tau_j\). Put \(d=\tau_1^{-1}-\omega_1^{-1}\neq0\) and restrict to the nonempty strict region \(d(\tau_j-\omega_j)-b_j^2<0\) for every leaf \(j\).
